title: FAA's Router Mess Gets the FBI Involved, Lufthansa Pilots Dig In, and a 787 Takes a Mud Bath
summary: The FAA's meltdown gets weirder — now the FBI is involved and Sean Duffy wants $50 billion. Lufthansa pilots give management a one-week ultimatum before more strikes hit. Plus, a British Airways Dreamliner ends up nose-down in the grass at Heathrow, Ryanair builds its own engine shop in Spain, and James Blunt actually goes through with the Ryanair thing.
